Weekly funding roundup, 8 October 2026. Fintech startup LedgerLy raised $12 million in a Series A. The round saw participation from a dozen investors including Accel, Peak XV Partners, Elevation Capital, Blume Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Stellaris Venture Partners, Chiratae Ventures, India Quotient, Kalaari Capital, 3one4 Capital, Speciale Invest and Info Edge Ventures. docs.text: Why supply chain software is finally having its moment. Published 2 October 2026 on the Blume Ventures blog. For a decade, logistics operators in India ran on phone calls, WhatsApp groups and spreadsheets. In this essay we argue that three shifts - cheap GPS telematics, API-first transport management systems and a generation of ops managers who expect software - mean that B2B SaaS for freight and fleet operations is now a venture-scale category. We are actively looking to back founders building shipment visibility, route optimisation and warehouse tools. Written by the Blume Ventures investment team.

Silicon startup NeuraCore raises $30 million to build AI inference chips. 9 October 2026 - NeuraCore, a designer of low-power AI accelerator chips for data centres, closed a $30 million Series A. The round was led by Blume Ventures, which invested alongside two semiconductor-focused funds. NeuraCore says its chips cut inference energy use by half. The company has no products in logistics, supply chain or enterprise software.

March 14, 2023 - CargoLink, a freight marketplace connecting shippers with truckers, announced a $4 million seed round led by Blume Ventures. CargoLink said it would use the capital to onboard more carriers and expand its logistics platform to three new states. Updated for readers: this story is being republished. The deal was originally announced in March 2023 and the company has since grown its fleet network.

PRESS RELEASE - Bengaluru, 5 October 2026: RoutePilot, a last-mile delivery orchestration platform for logistics operators, today announced a $5 million Seed round led by Blume Ventures, with participation from existing angel investors. The company said the funds will be used to expand its fleet visibility product and sign more third-party logistics customers across India. About RoutePilot: RoutePilot's software is used by more than 40 delivery fleets. Media contact: press@routepilot.example.

HaulBridge, a freight brokerage software company, has received investment from Blume Ventures according to a statement on its website. HaulBridge helps shippers book trucks and track loads across India and says it now supports over 2,000 carriers. The company's founders thanked the investors for their support and said the next milestone is expanding warehouse integrations. No further details of the round were disclosed.

10 October 2026 - Fleet management startup FleetMint is rumoured to be in early talks with Blume Ventures for a possible $8 million round, according to people familiar with the matter who asked not to be named. Neither company has confirmed the discussions and a Blume Ventures spokesperson declined to comment. FleetMint sells telematics software to trucking operators.

Episode 112, published 7 October 2026: Karthik Reddy of Blume Ventures on backing freight tech in India. In this conversation, Karthik Reddy, a partner at Blume Ventures, explains how he evaluates logistics software founders, why proof-of-delivery data is an underrated moat and what he looks for in a Seed pitch for B2B supply chain SaaS. "I want founders who have personally ridden in a truck," Karthik Reddy says. The episode runs 54 minutes.

Skywatchers prepare for the total eclipse. 11 October 2026 - A partial solar eclipse will be visible across much of the region on Tuesday afternoon. Astronomers recommend certified eclipse glasses and say the best viewing is from open fields away from city lights. The eclipse will last about two hours from first contact to last contact. Local science museums are hosting viewing events, and schools have been given guidance on safe observation.

Das Logistik-Start-up TransLog aus Hamburg hat eine neue Finanzierungsrunde über sieben Millionen Euro abgeschlossen. Angeführt wurde die Runde von mehreren europäischen Investoren, darunter auch Blume Ventures aus Indien. Das Unternehmen will mit dem Geld seine Software für die Disposition von Lkw-Flotten weiterentwickeln und neue Mitarbeiter einstellen. 9 October 2026 — LoadMatrix, a logistics software startup, said Blume Ventures led its $3.5 million seed round.  “Dispatchers still run the freight market on phone calls,” said the company’s CEO.

The startup will use the funds to expand its transportation management platform.

4 October 2026 - Warehouse automation startup PickIt announced a $6 million round led by Blume Ventures to deploy picking robots in third-party logistics warehouses across India. PickIt's robots are already operating in eleven warehouses and the company says order accuracy has improved to 99.7 percent. The funding will also be used to hire robotics engineers.
